restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรม สมภพ-อัมพุช
text:
Extremely disappointed with the reception service at this clinic.

I called to reschedule my appointment because I wasn’t available on the original date. Since it was only a routine check-up that would take around 15–20 minutes, I asked if I could move it to an earlier date.

The first receptionist told me that wasn’t possible and said the next available appointment would be almost two months later. I accepted it, although I found it surprising.

Later, I called again and spoke to a different receptionist, who immediately told me that an earlier appointment was available. Naturally, I asked why I had been told the opposite before. Her response, in a rude tone, was simply, “It was a different receptionist.”

What does that even mean? Are patients supposed to receive different answers depending on who picks up the phone? It suggests either inconsistent training or poor communication between staff, neither of which is acceptable.

To make matters worse, shortly after I hung up, the original receptionist called me back sounding upset and claimed she had never been informed that I wanted to move my appointment to an earlier date. That explanation makes no sense—the entire purpose of my call was to ask whether I could reschedule to an earlier date.

What frustrated me most was that, instead of acknowledging the misunderstanding or admitting that she may have made a mistake, she chose to make what sounded like an unreasonable excuse to avoid taking responsibility. A simple apology or explanation would have been far more professional than trying to shift the blame.

The lack of consistency, poor internal communication, and unprofessional attitude made what should have been a simple appointment change unnecessarily frustrating. I hope the clinic improves the training, communication, and professionalism of its reception staff so future patients don’t have to go through the same experience.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรม สมภพ-อัมพุช
text:
There are many excellent doctors, but they are expensive, it's difficult to get an appointment, and it's very difficult to contact the clinic.
I've already sent an email with feedback about the service. I hope to get a response; otherwise, I'll probably switch to another clinic.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรม สมภพ-อัมพุช
text: The service fee is extremely expensive. The service is like free service. Especially some doctors. They don't know where their magic comes from. They act like they are more skilled than others.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรม สมภพ-อัมพุช
text: Taking good care of dental health, from grandfather's generation to grandchildren's generation, is excellent!

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรม สมภพ-อัมพุช
text: I brought my child to the dentist here, and Dr. M provided excellent care. She's very understanding and communicative with young children. My child loves Dr. M very much.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรม สมภพ-อัมพุช
text: The clinic called to reschedule my appointment three or four times. When I couldn't make it due to other commitments, they got really rude and dismissive. It was a terrible experience.

text: The doctor is good and lovely, but the staff are rude and don't understand what you're saying.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์ทันตกรรม สมภพ-อัมพุช
text: Never meets customers on time. Customers always wait at least 1 hour. Very bad.

text: It used to be good, but now the billing process is incredibly slow. It takes half an hour. I'm not sure what the cashier is doing; it takes longer to process the bill than it does for a dentist to get their teeth cleaned.

text:
